  Special Meeting Agenda
  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, August 8, 2023  5:30 PM  Conference Room

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City Council, to be called to
order in the Conference Room of City Hall at 5:30 p.m. on Tuesday, August 8, 2023. The agenda for the Special
Meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth below.

Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, August 3, 2023.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstatesCA.gov
  and during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk.

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  AUGUST 8, 2023

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR HUFF at 5:30 PM.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
City Council Members Absent:  None

4.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  INTERVIEWS OF APPLICANTS TO FILL ONE PLANNING COMMISSION VACANCY

The City Council conducted interviews for the following applicants for the one (1) vacancy
on the Planning Commission:

  5:30 pm - Sheri Repp-Loadsman
  5:40 pm - Morley Mendelson
  5:50 pm - David Deane

5.  ADJOURNMENT

MAYOR HUFF adjourned the Special City Council meeting to the regular City Council
meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Britt Huff
City Clerk  Mayor

SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
AUGUST 8, 2023
